newsitem.title: FRANCE: Sanofi, Beckman in diagnostics deal.
newsitem.headline: Sanofi, Beckman in diagnostics deal.

text.p: Sanofi Diagnostics Pasteur said it had signed an agreement to sell its ACCESS sophisticated blood sample test equipment to Beckman Instruments Inc.
The deal entails the sale of some 300 million francs in assets, including a Chaska, Minnesota, site.
At the same time the two companies struck a long-term cooperation pact for industrial, commercial and scientific issues related to ACCESS.
Sanofi Diagnostics Pasteur will not sell the HIV/HCV parametres developed on ACCESS.
Sanofi Diagnostics Pasteur is 72 percent owned By Sanofi and the remainder by the Pasteur Institutes in Paris and Lille.
The alliance allows Sanofi Pasteur to concentrate on its expertise in biology while Beckman takes charge of the scientific instruments.
